title: Cumin Roasted Chickpeas
blurb: Crispy roasted chickpeas with cumin and a touch of salt, perfect for snacking or scattering over salads.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and lightly spray a large baking sheet with vegetable oil.
Drain the chickpeas thoroughly and pat them dry with kitchen paper to remove as much moisture as possible.
Tip the chickpeas into a bowl and toss with the olive oil, cumin and salt until evenly coated.
Spread the chickpeas in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast for 50 minutes, shaking the tray every 15 minutes, until the chickpeas are golden and crisp.
Let them cool completely on the tray before serving or storing in an airtight container.
